title: great value and super cute
text: I love love love these masks and I'm so glad I subscribed. I try to avoid subscription boxes because I know I'll go overboard and get ALL the subscription boxes but I caught this when there was a deal going on and figured $8/month afterward wasn't terrible. I alternate between these masks and my Queen Helene Mint Julep mask whenever I have an at-home spa day and I still always have one sheet mask left over when I get my new box. I have oily/acne prone skin and typically avoid super hydrating masks but these amazingly have not caused any breakouts. I also love that each box comes with a postcard, some stickers, and a description card for each mask. It's so cute and a small, but greatly appreciated treat every month :)
label: positive
